criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Solution architecture, integrations/APIs, scalability, performance and overall technical fit to the requirement.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Timeline realism, milestones, team structure and staffing, methodology, dependencies and delivery risk plan.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Pricing clarity, total cost of ownership, payment terms, stated assumptions and exclusions.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Security controls, certifications (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2), data privacy, encryption, access control and auditability.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Support model and SLAs, relevant similar projects, client references and years of experience.

formulas.benchmark: max(score) per criterion across suppliers in this run

criteria.justification: The proposal provides a detailed technical architecture with specific technologies and performance metrics, demonstrating strong technical capability.
criteria.evidence: Microservices on Kubernetes (AWS EKS, Mumbai region ap-south-1) with multi-AZ high availability and a 99.95% uptime design target. [Page 1]

criteria.justification: The implementation plan outlines a clear timeline with phases and milestones, though some details on methodology could be expanded.
criteria.evidence: Delivery follows a phased approach over 24 weeks: Discovery & design 1–5, Build & integrate 6–15, Testing 16–20, Go-live & hypercare 21–24. [Page 1]

criteria.justification: The commercial proposal is clear with detailed pricing and assumptions, but lacks information on total cost of ownership breakdown.
criteria.evidence: Total 3-year cost of ownership 2,85,00,000. Assumptions: prices exclude GST; Kestrel provides SAP basis access. [Page 1]

criteria.justification: The proposal includes specific security certifications and detailed security measures, demonstrating a strong commitment to compliance.
criteria.evidence: Certifications: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (certified since 2019) and SOC 2 Type II. [Page 1]

criteria.justification: The support model is well-defined with SLAs and relevant experience, though references are fictional and may not provide verifiable credibility.
criteria.evidence: Support: 24x7 helpdesk; P1 response time 30 minutes, P2 2 hours; named customer success manager. [Page 2]

risks: Some references are fictional, which may affect credibility.
suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems presents a strong proposal with detailed technical capabilities and a clear implementation plan. While the commercial aspects are mostly clear, the fictional nature of references raises some concerns about verifiability.
